name: @useyolo/metadata-tmdb
description: Official Yolo metadata plugin: confirms which film or episode an item is against The Movie Database and describes it, with posters, synopses, and cast photos, using the owner's own TMDB key

summary.en: Posters, synopses, and cast photos from TMDB, with your own key.
summary.zh: 用你自己的 key 从 TMDB 获取海报、简介和演员照片。

privacy.en: Sends the titles of your files to The Movie Database with your key.
privacy.zh: 用你的 key 把文件标题发给 The Movie Database。
